dedupe_keys.name: dsp based link tomography for amplifier gain estimation and anomaly detection in c l band systems

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Receiver signal processing reconstructs longitudinal per-channel power profiles and combines wavelengths to estimate spectral gain of C+L in-line erbium-doped amplifiers. Coverage is a 280-km single-mode-fibre experiment. The source compares estimates with back-to-back optical-spectrum-analyser characterisation and reports sub-dB agreement. Gain tilt and narrowband compression are evaluated as anomalies. This is a documented inverse model for optical infrastructure condition; the deposited paper does not establish public access to the received waveform samples. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
